source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "waste pickers" OR "home-based workers" OR "informal workers" AND city
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"waste pickers" OR "home-based workers" OR "informal workers" AND city,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("home-based workers" OR "waste pickers" OR ("informal workers" AND "city"))
